pages.transcription:
10 April 1940
HOTEL LOUVOIS
SQUARE LOUVOIS
Près l'Opéra
Télégr: HOTEL LOUVOIS PARIS
TÉLÉPH. { RICHELIEU 64-41
(10 Lignes groupées)

Paris, le

Dear Lotte, I am well
arrived, the voyage was
somewhat bumpy as we
flow very near over the
ground all the way but it
was delightful to see france
in sunshine. Today I got
only a charming room for
two (with bath 70 Francs)
tomorrow a get a single one
and it is not true that the
cafés are closed these times
pages.notes: Briefpapier des Hotel Louvois. Handschrift in violetter Tinte. Der Text 'tomorrow a get a single one' enthält eine kleine Korrektur/Wortwiederholung, die so transkribiert wurde.

pages.transcription:
a week - only no aperitifs.
I had to leave back my
little blue pocket-book {at the Customhouse} on behalf
of the many avenues. It will soon
be returned directly through the
censorship.
Now I have finished my
first letter and you have to
wait some time for the second
Best regard to you all

Stefan Zweig
pages.notes: Fortsetzung des Briefes. 'at the Customhouse' wurde über der Zeile eingefügt.
